contexts.text: Thou shalt be called Kephas, which, if thou interest it, is a rock (). Kephas means a rock in the Syriac language, and therefore also Peter in that text is everywhere called Kephas; and Kephas is also a rock in the Hebrew language, as is evident in ; and in , where rocks are mentioned in the plural.

As truth from good... is the first of the Church, therefore Peter was the first called, and was the first of the apostles; and was also named by the Lord Kephas, which is a rock; but in order that it might be the name of a person, he is called Peter. By a rock, in the supreme sense, is signified the Lord as to Divine truth, or the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord. Hence, in the relative sense, by a rock is signified truth from good which is from the Lord. In like manner by Peter.
